description:
You are a materials scientist analyzing a eutectic alloy microstructure image to quantitatively discriminate between two distinct microstructural phases using texture features.

## Image
Open the alloy microstructure image located at:
  ~/Fiji_Data/raw/alloy/AuPbSn40.jpg

This is an 8-bit grayscale micrograph of a Au-Pb-Sn eutectic alloy showing at least two visually distinct phases — a brighter, finer-textured phase ('Phase A') and a darker, coarser-textured phase ('Phase B').

## What You Need To Do

1. Open the image in Fiji. Convert to 8-bit grayscale if it is not already (Image > Type > 8-bit).

2. Using the Rectangle selection tool, define at least 6 square ROIs (~80-120 pixels per side):
   - At least 3 in Phase A (brighter regions). Name them PhaseA_1, PhaseA_2, PhaseA_3
   - At least 3 in Phase B (darker regions). Name them PhaseB_1, PhaseB_2, PhaseB_3
   Add each to the ROI Manager (press T) and rename accordingly.

3. Save all ROIs: In the ROI Manager, select all ROIs, then More > Save... to:
   ~/Fiji_Data/results/texture/rois.zip

4. For each ROI, compute texture features. You have two approaches:
   a) PREFERRED: Use Plugins > GLCM Texture Too (step size=1, angle=0°). Record ASM, Contrast, Correlation, IDM, Entropy for each ROI.
   b) ALTERNATIVE: Duplicate the image, apply Process > Filters > Variance (radius=3), then Analyze > Measure on each ROI. Record Mean, StdDev, Min, Max from both original and variance-filtered images.

5. Save all measurements to a CSV file:
   ~/Fiji_Data/results/texture/glcm_measurements.csv
   The CSV must have a header row. First column: ROI name (e.g., PhaseA_1). Remaining columns: numeric texture feature values. One row per ROI, at least 6 rows total.

6. Create an annotated overlay image showing the ROI rectangles drawn on the microstructure. In the ROI Manager, select all ROIs, click 'Show All', then use Image > Overlay > From ROI Manager (or Flatten). Save as:
   ~/Fiji_Data/results/texture/annotated_microstructure.png

7. Write a summary report:
   ~/Fiji_Data/results/texture/texture_report.txt
   Include:
   - Mean ± StdDev of each texture feature for Phase A and Phase B separately
   - Which feature best discriminates between the two phases (largest difference)
   - A brief conclusion stating whether texture analysis can distinguish the two phases

## Output Summary
All outputs go to ~/Fiji_Data/results/texture/:
  - rois.zip (ROI set, ≥6 ROIs)
  - glcm_measurements.csv (header + ≥6 data rows)
  - annotated_microstructure.png (overlay image, >10 KB)
  - texture_report.txt (summary with statistics and conclusion, >200 bytes)
